title: commitVelocity lane suppression allowlist
description: Suppressions for the commit-velocity lane (bin/commit-velocity.mjs). Applied by loadAllowlist() there; a document that fails this schema is treated exactly as an unreadable one — NOTHING is suppressed and summary.allowlistUnreadable says so. Every entry is strict: repo-optional, rule + author + expires mandatory. An acknowledged agent-fleet identity is suppressed per RULE, never wholesale: a known fast committer is expected to trip machine-speed-commits, and its workflow-edit-burst or sensitive-file-burst still fires unless listed separately. `expires` carries a date pattern because the code's expiry check is `Date.parse(x) < now`, so an unparseable expiry would fail the guard rather than the entry and suppress forever.

repo.description: Scopes the entry to one scanned tree (the checkout's basename). ABSENT means the entry applies only to commitwork's own tree — absence is a real scope here, not a missing value.

author.description: The finding's author identity: either the exact `Name <email>` the finding carries as `path`, or the bare email. Keyed on the identity, never on a commit or a count.

expires.description: YYYY-MM-DD, optionally with a time suffix. Mandatory: a permanent blindfold over a rate signal is refused by shape.
